text: Segons el refrany, a l'abril, cada gota val per…
gloss: According to the proverb, in April every drop is worth... what? — A thousand: «A l'abril, cada gota val per mil».

text: Quin objecte s'acostuma a regalar, juntament amb una rosa, el dia de Sant Jordi?
gloss: Which object is traditionally given with a rose on Saint George's Day? — A book (23 April, Diada de Sant Jordi, also the book day).

text: Quants mesos de l'any tenen almenys 28 dies?
gloss: How many months of the year have at least 28 days? — All twelve: February has 28 and every other month has more. The trap is answering 'only February'.

text: Les aranyes no són insectes. Quantes potes tenen?
gloss: Spiders are not insects. How many legs do they have? — Eight (insects have six, which is the tempting option).

text: Per a una coca gran calen dues dotzenes i mitja d'ous. Quants ous són?
gloss: A big cake needs two dozen and a half dozen eggs. How many eggs? — 30: two dozen is 24, plus half a dozen (6).

text: Quin ball tradicional català es balla en rotllana, agafats de les mans, al so d'una cobla?
gloss: Which traditional Catalan dance is danced in a circle, hand in hand, to a cobla band? — The sardana. The others are circle or folk dances from Greece, Italy and Andalusia.

text: Quin és l'únic estat del món on el català és l'única llengua oficial?
gloss: Which is the only state in the world where Catalan is the sole official language? — Andorra. Monaco, Malta and Luxembourg are small European states with other official languages.

text: Un dia assolellat, quan és més curta l'ombra que fa un arbre?
gloss: On a sunny day, when is a tree's shadow shortest? — Around midday, when the Sun is highest in the sky.

text: Quin cavaller de la novel·la de Cervantes confon els molins de vent amb gegants i els ataca?
gloss: Which knight in Cervantes' novel mistakes windmills for giants and attacks them? — Don Quixote. Sancho is his squire; Tirant and Amadís are other chivalric heroes.

text: Quin riu travessa París i envolta l'illa de la Cité, on s'alça Notre-Dame?
gloss: Which river crosses Paris and surrounds the Île de la Cité, home of Notre-Dame? — The Seine. The others are other major French rivers.

text: El nom del mes de setembre ve del llatí «septem», que vol dir «set». Quin lloc ocupa, doncs, aquest mes a l'any actualment?
gloss: September comes from Latin 'septem' (seven). Which place does it hold in the year today? — Ninth: the Roman year began in March, then January and February were put at the start, so the numbered months shifted by two.

text: Quin llegum és la base de l'hummus?
gloss: Which legume is the base of hummus? — The chickpea (cigró), blended with tahini, lemon and garlic.

text: Un nadó neix amb prop de tres-cents ossos, que es van soldant amb els anys. Quants ossos té una persona adulta?
gloss: A baby is born with nearly 300 bones that fuse over the years. How many does an adult have? — 206.

text: Quina civilització va bastir la ciutadella de Machu Picchu, als Andes?
gloss: Which civilisation built the citadel of Machu Picchu in the Andes? — The Incas (15th century). Aztecs, Maya and Olmecs were Mesoamerican peoples.

text: En quina ciutat de l'Empordà hi ha el Teatre-Museu Dalí?
gloss: In which Empordà town is the Dalí Theatre-Museum? — Figueres, Dalí's birthplace. Cadaqués (where he lived in Portlligat) is the tempting wrong option.

text: «Rentaplats» es forma amb un verb (renta) i un nom en plural (plats). Quina d'aquestes paraules es forma de la mateixa manera?
gloss: 'Rentaplats' is verb + plural noun. Which of these is built the same way? — 'Portamonedes' (porta + monedes). Aiguamoll is noun + adjective, mitjanit is adjective + noun, campanar is noun + suffix.

text: Quin nombre continua la sèrie 2, 3, 5, 8, 12…?
gloss: Which number continues 2, 3, 5, 8, 12…? — 17: the gaps grow by one each time (+1, +2, +3, +4, +5).

text: En un castell humà, quin casteller corona la construcció i aixeca la mà fent l'«aleta»?
gloss: In a human tower, who tops the structure and raises a hand in the 'aleta'? — The enxaneta, the child who climbs last. The others are other roles in the tower.

text: Quin d'aquests mamífers és l'únic capaç de volar activament, batent les ales?
gloss: Which of these mammals is the only one capable of true flight? — The bat. Flying squirrels only glide.

text: En quin torneig del Grand Slam ha guanyat més títols el mallorquí Rafael Nadal?
gloss: In which Grand Slam has Rafael Nadal, from Mallorca, won the most titles? — Roland Garros (14).

text: Quin és el punt més alt de Catalunya, a la frontera amb França?
gloss: What is the highest point of Catalonia, on the French border? — Pica d'Estats (3,143 m). Aneto is the highest of the Pyrenees but lies in Aragon.

text: Quina escriptora és l'autora de «La plaça del Diamant», novel·la ambientada al barri de Gràcia?
gloss: Which writer wrote 'La plaça del Diamant', set in Barcelona's Gràcia district? — Mercè Rodoreda (1962). The others are other well-known Catalan women writers.

text: Un got ple d'aigua fins a la vora conté un glaçó que hi flota. Què passarà quan el glaçó es fongui del tot?
options: Depèn de la mida del glaçó
gloss: A glass is filled to the brim with a floating ice cube. What happens when it melts? — Nothing spills: a floating cube displaces exactly its own weight of water, and melting turns it into just that volume.

text: Si ordenem alfabèticament els noms dels nombres de l'u al vint, escrits en català, quin d'aquests va primer?
gloss: Ordering the Catalan number words from one to twenty alphabetically, which comes first? — 'Catorze' (14): 'ca' comes before 'ci' (cinc), 'de', 'di', 'qu' and so on.

text: Un llibre i un punt de llibre costen 11 € en total. El llibre costa 10 € més que el punt de llibre. Quant costa el punt de llibre?
gloss: A book and a bookmark cost 11 € together; the book costs 10 € more than the bookmark. Price of the bookmark? — 0.50 € (0.50 + 10.50 = 11). The trap is 1 €, from simply subtracting 10 from 11.

text: A quin segle pertany l'any 1900?
gloss: Which century does the year 1900 belong to? — The 19th: centuries run from year 1 to 100, so the 19th century is 1801–1900 and the 20th starts in 1901.

text: El primer ferrocarril de la península Ibèrica, inaugurat el 1848, unia Barcelona amb quina ciutat?
gloss: The first railway of the Iberian Peninsula, opened in 1848, linked Barcelona to which city? — Mataró.

text: El mes de gener deu el nom a un déu romà amb dues cares, una mirant enrere i l'altra endavant. Quin?
gloss: January is named after a Roman god with two faces, looking back and forward. Which? — Janus, god of doors and beginnings (Latin Ianuarius).

text: Quin director japonès va rodar «Els set samurais»?
gloss: Which Japanese director made 'Seven Samurai' (1954)? — Akira Kurosawa. Miyazaki is an animation director, Ozu and Kitano are other well-known Japanese filmmakers.

text: Quina d'aquestes ciutats queda més al sud, és a dir, té la latitud més baixa?
gloss: Which of these cities lies furthest south? — New York (40.7° N), south of Barcelona (41.4°), Rome (41.9°) and Bucharest (44.4°). Most people assume the Mediterranean cities are further south.

text: Quin arquitecte va projectar tant el Palau de la Música Catalana com l'Hospital de Sant Pau, tots dos Patrimoni Mundial?
gloss: Which architect designed both the Palau de la Música Catalana and the Hospital de Sant Pau, both World Heritage sites? — Lluís Domènech i Montaner. Gaudí is the tempting wrong option.

text: En quin mes de l'any passa la Terra més a prop del Sol?
gloss: In which month is the Earth closest to the Sun? — January (perihelion around 3 January). Seasons come from the tilt of the axis, not from distance, so July (the hot month in the north) is the trap.

text: Cleòpatra va viure, en el temps, més a prop de l'arribada de l'ésser humà a la Lluna que de…
options: els primers Jocs Olímpics de l'antiguitat
la construcció de la Gran Piràmide de Giza
gloss: Cleopatra lived closer in time to the Moon landing than to... — the building of the Great Pyramid (c. 2560 BC, about 2,500 years before her; the Moon landing is about 2,000 years after her). The other three events are all within about 750 years of her.

text: Quin d'aquests països no té sortida al mar?
gloss: Which of these countries is landlocked? — Hungary. Slovenia has a short Adriatic coast, Croatia the Adriatic, Bulgaria the Black Sea.

text: Qui s'amagava darrere el pseudònim de Víctor Català, autora de la novel·la «Solitud»?
gloss: Who hid behind the pen name Víctor Català, author of 'Solitud' (1905)? — Caterina Albert, from L'Escala. The others are Catalan women writers of the same period.

text: Escala i corda, galotxa i raspall són modalitats d'un esport tradicional valencià. Quin?
gloss: Escala i corda, galotxa and raspall are variants of which traditional Valencian sport? — Pilota valenciana (Valencian ball game).

text: Quants valors diferents pot guardar un únic byte?
gloss: How many different values can one byte hold? — 256: a byte is 8 bits and each bit has two states, 2^8 = 256.

text: Quin dels espais naturals següents és l'únic parc nacional de Catalunya?
options: Aigüestortes i Estany de Sant Maurici
gloss: Which of these natural areas is the only national park in Catalonia? — Aigüestortes i Estany de Sant Maurici. Montseny, Cap de Creus and the Ebre Delta are natural parks.

text: Quin pintor neerlandès va fer «La ronda de nit», l'obra més famosa del Rijksmuseum d'Amsterdam?
gloss: Which Dutch painter made 'The Night Watch', the Rijksmuseum's most famous work? — Rembrandt (1642). The others are Dutch Golden Age contemporaries.

text: Una girafa i una persona tenen, al coll, el mateix nombre de vèrtebres. Quantes?
gloss: A giraffe and a person have the same number of neck vertebrae. How many? — Seven, as in almost all mammals; the giraffe's are just very long.

text: Quin poeta valencià del segle XV és l'autor dels «Cants d'amor» i dels «Cants de mort»?
gloss: Which 15th-century Valencian poet wrote the 'Cants d'amor' and 'Cants de mort'? — Ausiàs March. The others are Valencian writers of the same century.

text: Quin d'aquests monuments de Barcelona es va construir com a porta d'entrada de l'Exposició Universal del 1888?
gloss: Which Barcelona monument was built as the entrance gate of the 1888 Universal Exposition? — The Arc de Triomf. The other three belong to the 1929 International Exposition on Montjuïc.

text: Quin any es van aprovar les Normes ortogràfiques de l'Institut d'Estudis Catalans, redactades per Pompeu Fabra?
gloss: In which year were the orthographic norms of the Institut d'Estudis Catalans, drafted by Pompeu Fabra, approved? — 1913. 1907 is the Institut's founding, 1918 Fabra's grammar, 1932 the Normes de Castelló.

text: Quina illa de les Balears va ser declarada Reserva de la Biosfera per la UNESCO el 1993?
gloss: Which Balearic island was declared a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve in 1993? — Menorca. Mallorca's Serra de Tramuntana is World Heritage (2011), a different distinction.

text: Quin planeta triga més a girar sobre si mateix que a fer una volta al Sol, de manera que el seu dia és més llarg que el seu any?
gloss: Which planet takes longer to rotate once than to orbit the Sun, so its day is longer than its year? — Venus (rotation about 243 Earth days, orbit about 225). Mercury rotates in about 59 days and orbits in 88.

text: Quin escriptor mexicà és l'autor de la novel·la «Pedro Páramo», publicada el 1955?
gloss: Which Mexican writer wrote 'Pedro Páramo' (1955)? — Juan Rulfo. García Márquez, who admired the book, is Colombian.

text: Quin és el menor nombre que es pot dividir exactament per tots els nombres de l'1 al 10?
gloss: What is the smallest number divisible by all of 1 to 10? — 2,520 (2³·3²·5·7). 840 is not divisible by 9, 1,260 not by 8, and 5,040 is a common multiple but not the smallest.

text: El nom d'un d'aquests gasos nobles ve del grec per a «nou». Quin?
gloss: One of these noble gases is named from the Greek for 'new'. Which? — Neon (neos). Argon means 'lazy', krypton 'hidden', xenon 'stranger'.

text: En quin centre de recerca va proposar Tim Berners-Lee, el 1989, la idea de la World Wide Web?
gloss: At which research centre did Tim Berners-Lee propose the World Wide Web in 1989? — CERN, near Geneva. The others are famous US research labs.

text: Qui va comandar la nau Victòria en el tram final de la primera volta al món, després de la mort de Magallanes?
gloss: Who commanded the ship Victoria on the final leg of the first circumnavigation, after Magellan's death? — Juan Sebastián Elcano (Joan Sebastià Elcano). The others were other great navigators.
